caption: The drawing depicts two identical objects resembling small purses or bags, each shown with a squared bottom and a semi-circular handle attached at the top. Both objects are composed of a grid pattern suggesting a needlepoint or cross-stitch design. The top bag features a handle decorated with a yellow background and gray and black spiral motifs; the main body displays a floral pattern with pink, red, blue, and yellow flowers with green leaves distributed across the surface, and its lower section has a geometric border in red, green, and blue. The bottom bag has a similar yellow and gray handle and its upper section is adorned with evenly spaced blue diamond motifs forming vertical lines. At the center, there are two lines of characters or symbols stitched in dark colors. The lower portion of this bag displays a multicolored geometric pattern including shades of blue, purple, green, and red arranged in a stepped design. Both bags are drawn within a lightly outlined rectangular frame against a plain cream background.
title: Purse
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
